integrity: The proof uses the defining condition that the zero set is not dominating to force an all-positive blade and a positive center. Weight r+1 is impossible. At weight r+2, a center label one leaves only one spare unit; with at least three blades this leaves a completely zero blade whose vertices receive only one unit, so the center must be two. The remaining r units then force exactly one whole blade to carry label one.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least three clique blades; the two-blade case has additional optimum types.
The scalar value r+2 is already implied by the published universal-join theorem and is not the originality basis.
The theorem classifies minimum functions only, not the full starred Italian weight enumerator.
Finite exhaustive verification covers nine small parameter pairs and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed minimum-function classification may exist.
title: All minimum starred Italian functions of generalized windmills
